_comment: Every shell is shot from its own ENTRANCE at eye height on the
engine's lens, because a corridor's whole design is what you can see
when you step into it. The four are one family only if those four
The runner yaws models 180 degrees, so a shell built to run along
Godot +Z runs toward -Z here: the camera stands at +Z looking back.

CAMERA FRAME: the runner yaws the MODEL 180 degrees and leaves the camera in world space, so any `eye` meant to stand INSIDE a shell must negate the manifest anchor's x and z. The first pass did not, and the two 'from high' shots were taken from out in the void, looking at the corridor through its own entrance -- with captions claiming otherwise.

S_bays_approach is shot from the LANE, not from inside a bay: 1.6 m deep by 2.8 wide means the view OUT of a bay is a slot, which is true of the shape and useless as evidence. The pocket reads as a pocket on approach.
